items.raw_excerpt: We built HALO (Hierarchal Agent Loop Optimizer), an open-source tool for debugging and optimizing AI agents using their execution traces. It’s a loop. Run your agent, feed the traces to HALO, get the report, apply the fixes, then re-run your agent. excerpt_i18n.en: At the opening of ISC.AI 2026 (the 14th Internet Security Conference) today, Zhou Hongyi, founder of 360 Group, officially unveiled two core AI security capabilities of 360, named "Yi Tian Tu Long" (Heaven-Slaying Dragon): the automated vulnerability discovery agent "Tu Long Feng" (Dragon-Slaying Edge) and the network security automated defense system "Yi Tian Zhen" (Heaven-Shielding Array). Meanwhile, 360, together with industry partners including Feiteng, Kylin, and others in the fields of Xinchuang, security, cloud computing, large models, and computing power, jointly launched the "Rock Shield" security collaboration initiative. Recently, Anthropic announced restrictions on public access to its strongest internal model, Mythos, sparking widespread concern in the global security industry. Shortly after the model's debut, it triggered a collective plunge in the stock prices of major U.S. cybersecurity giants. Zhou Hongyi believes that the fundamental reason Mythos caused such a shock is its ability to autonomously discover vulnerabilities, analyze them, and even construct cyberattack "weapons"—essentially acting as a "cyber nuclear weapon" in the AI era, creating a new strategic deterrent. Over the past 30 years, the balance between cyber offense and defense has largely relied on the difficulty of finding vulnerabilities. High-value vulnerabilities are limited in number and costly to discover, often only within the reach of a few top security experts and national-level teams with sustained exploitation capabilities. But AI is changing all of that. It makes vulnerability discovery faster, cheaper, and more scalable—replicating capabilities previously held by a select few. A large number of long-latent, hard-to-find legacy vulnerabilities will be unearthed. When vulnerabilities shift from a scarce resource to a large-scale one, the rules of the cybersecurity industry, which have governed for 30 years, will be completely rewritten.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la inauguración hoy del ISC.AI 2026 (14.ª Conferencia de Seguridad en Internet), Zhou Hongyi, fundador de 360 Group, presentó oficialmente las dos capacidades centrales de seguridad de IA de 360: el agente de detección automatizada de vulnerabilidades "Tulong Feng" y el sistema de defensa automatizado de ciberseguridad "Yitian Zhen". Al mismo tiempo, 360, junto con socios industriales como Feiteng y Qilin en los ámbitos de innovación tecnológica, seguridad, computación en la nube, modelos grandes y potencia de cómputo, lanzó conjuntamente el plan de colaboración en seguridad "Escudo de Roca Firme". Recientemente, Anthropic anunció la restricción del acceso público a su modelo interno más potente, Mythos, lo que ha suscitado una amplia atención en la industria de la seguridad mundial. Ya en las primeras etapas de la aparición de este modelo, provocó una serie de reacciones entre las empresas de ciberseguridad de Estados Unidos.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Lei Feng exclusively learned that Qingyan Precision, a Tsinghua-incubated physical AI company, has recently completed a B3 funding round of several hundred million yuan. This round was led by the Beijing Green Energy Fund and BAIC Capital, with Yulon Group participating as a follow-on investor. The funds will be used for core talent recruitment, R&D and large-scale deployment of multimodal data acquisition equipment, as well as computing power procurement and model training infrastructure construction.  

01 Tsinghua-incubated, spanning multiple fields including automotive  
Founded in 2018 and incubated by Tsinghua University, Qingyan Precision is dedicated to building an engineering foundation for physical AI. The founder and CEO, Dong Han, holds a Ph.D. from Tsinghua University and studied under Professor Li Keqiang, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. He has nearly a decade of research and industry experience in the automotive sector. The Director of Strategic Development and CEO of Precision Vision, Cao Qitong, holds a Master’s degree in Management Science and Engineering from Stanford University and a Bachelor’s degree in Applied Mathematics from Duke University. The core research team and collaborators come from top universities such as Tsinghua, Stanford, Zhejiang University, Beihang University, and Xi’an Jiaotong University. They integrate autonomous driving engineering with interdisciplinary computing capabilities, adapting to core business areas such as industrial multimodal perception and physical simulation under complex working conditions, providing technical support for industrial-grade applications.  

Currently, Qingyan Precision has integrated its AI inspection, simulation, and testing verification products into the core supply chains of over 100 domestic OEMs, as well as power battery and energy storage companies. Its customers span automotive, new energy, engineering machinery, and low-altitude economy sectors.
excerpt_i18n.es: El medio Leiphone ha sabido en exclusiva que la empresa de IA física de la Universidad de Tsinghua, «Qingyan Precision», ha completado recientemente una ronda de financiación B3 de varios cientos de millones de yuanes. Esta ronda está liderada por el Fondo de Energía Verde de Pekín y BAIC Capital, con la participación de Yulon Group. Se informa que los fondos se destinarán a la contratación de talento clave, el desarrollo y despliegue a gran escala de dispositivos de recopilación de datos multimodales, así como a la adquisición de capacidad de cómputo y la construcción de infraestructura para el entrenamiento de modelos. 01 Origen en la Universidad de Tsinghua, con negocio que abarca múltiples sectores como el automotriz. Fundada en 2018 e incubada por la Universidad de Tsinghua, Qingyan Precision se dedica a construir la base de ingeniería de la IA física. El fundador y CEO de Qingyan Precision, Dong Han, es doctor por la Universidad de Tsinghua y alumno de la Academia China de Ingeniería.

items.raw_excerpt: 要闻提示 1.外媒：三星、SK 海力士员工已跻身韩国婚恋市场顶层 2.急缺人才！DeepSeek Harness负责人坦言每日不停面试招人 3.微信迎来史上最大更新！多项功能全面升级 4.字节跳动CEO梁汝波：收缩业务宽度，聚焦AI 5.刘强东的京东工业，失去一员大将！49岁CEO宋春正因健康原因辞职 6.腾讯考虑退出多家日本游戏公司投资 7.大疆Osmo Pocket 4P开售秒罄，二手市场现货溢价破千元 8.抢先苹果！Meta发布首款自有品牌智能眼镜：定价299美元起 今日头条 外媒：三星、SK 海力士员工已跻身韩国婚恋市场顶层 6 月 23 日消息，有外媒发布长文指出，全球 AI 热潮不仅把 SK 海力士和三星电子推成韩国股市宠儿，也显著提高了两家公司员工在婚恋市场上的地位。韩国多家婚介机构表示，AI 带动存储芯片需求激增，两家公司员工获得丰厚奖金，由此形成一批高收入群体。在婚恋市场上，SK 海力士和三星电子员工已经可以和医生、律师等传统精英职业从业者相提并论。 高薪和良好前景也吸引了越来越多求职者，亦有高中生把进入三星电子或 SK 海力士作为职业目标。一些培训机构已经开设专门课程，帮助求职者准备两家公司的面试。AI 热潮推高了存储芯片需求，也让两家公司股价和利润不断刷新纪录。周一，SK 海力士市值超过三星电子，成为韩国市值最高的公司。 员工收入同样水涨船高。SK 海力士去年调整了奖金制度，三星电子上月也与工会达成薪酬协议，部分芯片业务员工可获得约 41.6 万美元（约合 282.3 万元人民币）绩效奖金。相比之下，韩国政府数据显示，2024 年韩国劳动者平均年收入约为 4500 万韩元（约合 19.9 万元人民币）。（IT之家） 国内资讯 急缺人才！DeepSeek Harness负责人坦言每日不停面试招人 6月23日消息，据报道，DeepSeek Harness团
